extracted.intended_audience: journalists, scientists, and press officers (esp. UK science media)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on how journalists, scientists, and press officers can work with the Science Media Centre (SMC), what services it provides, and who the SMC primarily serves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ultimate goal: facilitate scientist engagement with media
rubrics_metrics.description: Our ultimate goal is to facilitate more scientists to engage with the media, in the hope that the public will have improved access to accurate, evidence-based scientific information about the stories of the day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This statement frames the SMC's purpose and prioritises activities that increase scientists' media engagement and public access to accurate, evidence-based science relevant to current news stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide journalists with what they need in the timeframe they need
rubrics_metrics.description: The Science Media Centre provides journalists with what they need in the timeframe they need it, from interviews with leading experts to timely press briefings on topical issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services include arranging interviews with leading experts and organising timely briefings on topical issues. The SMC focuses on being responsive and timely to meet journalists' deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supply accessible, evidence-based information and expertise to journalists
rubrics_metrics.description: We provide journalists with information about science and its related disciplines, making it easier for them to get access to the best evidence and expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on helping journalists access high-quality evidence and expert commentary to inform reporting; implies SMC expects materials and contacts it facilitates to be evidence-based and expert-led.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary journalist audience: science and news journalists at UK national outlets
rubrics_metrics.description: Given our focus on science in the headlines, the SMC works mainly with science and news journalists in the UK’s national news outlets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals prioritisation: activities and resources are chiefly targeted at UK national science and news media rather than all media types or international outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Help scientists, engineers and experts engage with media
rubrics_metrics.description: We work with scientists, engineers and other experts, helping them engage with the media and creating more opportunities for them to get their voices heard on the big science, health and environment stories of the day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SMC offers support aimed at enabling experts to be media-facing: engagement coaching, opportunities to be heard on major topical stories, and facilitation of media interactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide events, guidelines and top tips on media work for scientists
rubrics_metrics.description: The SMC also runs regular events to introduce experts to what media work involves, and provides guidelines and top tips on media work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical support includes training events and written guidance; implies expected behaviours and skills for scientists when dealing with media (e.g., preparing for interviews, clear messaging).

rubrics_metrics.name: Work closely with press officers from universities, industry and funders
rubrics_metrics.description: Primarily a press office, the Science Media Centre works closely with press officers from universities, industry, research funders, and other leading science and engineering institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SMC positions itself as a partner to institutional press offices, implying collaboration on story-handling, access to experts, and coordination of messaging for complex science stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support press officers on complex science, health and environment stories
rubrics_metrics.description: We support them when they are working on complex science, health and environment stories, providing advice and an independent neutral venue where the science and engineering communities can come together to speak out on issues of major concern.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support includes advisory help, and offering an independent/neutral convening space; implies SMC expects to be used for clarity, neutrality and collective expert response on major or contentious issues.
